review_metadata.reviewer_role: Role F successor (task-20), independent phase-three audit
review_metadata.scope_note: Read-only audit of experiments/phase_three/run_phase_three.py, mapmatch/phase_models.py, scripts/phase_three_decoder.py, scripts/live_evidence.py, visualizations/phase_three/generate_phase_three.py, shared caches and phase records. Reviewer writes only analysis/review/phase_three/.

defects.title: Prefit candidate-miss assertion counted empty candidate sets instead of target-missing observations
defects.evidence: Earlier revision used int((np.diff(dataset.offsets) == 0).sum()) != spec['misses'], which compares EMPTY candidate sets (both caches have 0) against declared target misses (TRAIN 578, student 19), so load always failed. Current code computes per-observation zero-positive-target counts via cumsum and compares to spec.
defects.reproducer: Independent recomputation on both frozen caches: TRAIN zero_positive_obs=578 == spec 578 (28000 obs, 0 empty sets); student 19 == 19 (19160 obs, 0 empty sets). Cache sha256 verification passes; runner stage cv passed cache load (logistic_regression.json reuse record written 2026-11-18 11:58).
defects.actual: Fixed and empirically verified in the running revision.
defects.recommended_fix: None remaining. Gap: no permanent regression test in tests/ for this assertion semantics (out of reviewer write scope).
defects.note: The running CV process (PID 142405, started 11:58) uses the fixed code: the LR reuse record could only be written after load_cached_dataset succeeded.

defects.title: clean_environment_smoke_load records PARENT interpreter versions under a .venv-clean label and skips exact cross-environment probability equality
defects.evidence: The child process runs .venv-clean/bin/python and prints only ok/predictions/min/max/classes; the report dict labels python='.venv-clean/bin/python' but fills versions from versions() executed in the PARENT process. The fixture check is finite/range-only. Lead instruction required the child's actual versions and exact deterministic probability equality between environments.
defects.reproducer: After freeze, read artifacts/phase_three/clean_load_report.json: 'versions' will equal the parent interpreter versions (e.g., numpy 2.5.2 when launched from .venv) while 'python' names .venv-clean. No field captures child versions and no exact-equality comparison exists.
defects.expected: Report contains the child interpreter's versions and an exact (or tolerance-stated) probability equality check against the parent-environment fixture prediction.
defects.actual: Versions provenance is mislabeled; equality is unverified (only finite/range).
defects.recommended_fix: Have the child print its versions() (or json of the probe result) and capture it in the report; compare child predictions to the parent fixture probabilities exactly (deterministic pipeline) or with a stated tolerance, and record max abs diff.

defects.title: stage_hpo and stage_cv have no existing-result guard; rerun truncates HPO trial log and repeats all CV fits
defects.evidence: stage_hpo unconditionally truncates experiments/phase_three/bayesian_trials.jsonl and re-runs all 7 CV evaluations even when bayesian_optimization.json already exists. stage_cv likewise re-fits KNN/Bagging without checking existing records. PROTOCOL.md declares stages idempotent/refusing. Contrast: scripts/phase_three_decoder.py refuses when outputs exist (lines 317-318, 562-563).
defects.reproducer: Run --stage hpo twice: second run rewrites bayesian_trials.jsonl from empty and repeats ~7 x 3-fold CV fits; results are deterministic but compute is wasted and any concurrent reader sees a truncated log mid-run.
defects.expected: Refuse (or require explicit --force) when the stage's final output already exists.
defects.recommended_fix: Add the same exists-guard pattern used by the decoder script.

defects.title: stage_freeze can overwrite an already-frozen model; 'immutable_after_freeze' claim is unenforced
defects.lines: 474-592 (no guard; claim at 581; atomic rewrite at 553-555)
defects.evidence: Rerunning --stage freeze (or --stage all after freeze) unconditionally rewrites artifacts/phase_three/model.joblib, model_metadata.json, feature_schema.json, model_freeze.json, clean_load_report.json. The freeze record itself asserts extras.immutable_after_freeze=true. Deployment evidence and decoder freeze.json pin sha256 of these bytes; a rewrite silently invalidates them.
defects.reproducer: Run --stage freeze twice: model.joblib mtime/sha change (joblib compress output is deterministic for identical inputs, but any drift in code/params/env rewrites different bytes) and model_freeze.json frozen_at_utc changes while still claiming immutability.
defects.recommended_fix: Guard at stage_freeze entry: if model_freeze.json exists, exit with the existing freeze signal instead of refitting/rewriting.

defects.title: GP-EI proposal can be silently replaced by a random draw yet keep the model-based label
defects.evidence: After the EI pool uniqueness check, the while-loop re-draws a uniform random vector if the decoded parameters collide with a seen config, but the record still names the proposal gaussian_process_expected_improvement. Near-impossible in practice (chosen_pos already filters seen decodes); vectors.append records the replacement vector so the surrogate stays consistent.
defects.reproducer: Construct a search space where two distinct unit-cube vectors decode to identical parameters (e.g., a space whose bounds collapse); record shows gp_ei label for a random draw.
defects.expected: Label reflects the actual proposal mechanism.
defects.actual: Mislabel possible in the collision corner case.
defects.recommended_fix: Set proposal='seeded_initial_design' (or 'collision_fallback') when the fallback loop triggers.

defects.title: HPO budget accounting needs Lead adjudication: 8 trials TOTAL vs 'GP-EI 8'
defects.evidence: Implemented budget: HPO_TRIALS=8 total = 1 measured prior + 2 seeded + 5 GP-EI model-based trials. This matches experiments/phase_three/PROTOCOL.md (frozen, d8784a80...) and run_config.json, and matches the predeclared phase plan. The task briefing phrase 'true GP-EI 8 budget' could be read as 8 model-based GP-EI proposals (the historical 12-trial run had 1+3+8).
defects.reproducer: Count bayesian_trials.jsonl records post-HPO: expect 8 lines with proposal counts {measured_baseline_prior:1, seeded_initial_design:2, gaussian_process_expected_improvement:5}.
defects.expected: Unambiguous budget wording in the final report.
defects.actual: Code follows the frozen PROTOCOL (8 total); briefing wording is ambiguous.
defects.recommended_owner: Lead adjudication; report wording must state '8 trials total: 1 measured prior, 2 seeded, 5 GP-EI' if the current implementation stands.
defects.recommended_fix: No code change unless Lead intends 8 GP-EI proposals; then HPO_TRIALS must become 11 and PROTOCOL must be re-frozen.

defects.title: If LR is selected with HPO winner == defaults, the student table mixes two different fits of the identical configuration
defects.lines: 649-661 vs 716+ (baseline reuse row vs tuned fresh-fit row)
defects.evidence: The baseline row reuses the historical shared all80 LR student evaluation (numbers from an earlier fit); the tuned row predicts from the fresh phase-three freeze refit of the same parameters. lbfgs on identical data/weights/seed should coincide, but nothing asserts the metrics agree, and the two rows share one parameters value.
defects.reproducer: Select LR, run HPO where best remains {C:1.0, max_iter:500, solver:lbfgs}; results.json comparison shows two rows with identical parameters from different fits.
defects.expected: Either a single consistent row or an explicit equality assertion across the two fits.
defects.recommended_fix: When tuned parameters == baseline parameters, reuse one evaluation and drop the duplicate, or assert metric agreement within tolerance and note the double fit.

defects.title: LR reuse validation does not assert OOF array identity with the cache
defects.evidence: stage_cv validates the shared LR OOF only by length plus 4 recomputed metrics (1e-9). The saved npz's y/offsets/observation_trip_ids are not compared to the TRAIN cache arrays. Reviewer verified equality independently (y, offsets, trips all array_equal True against the frozen cache), so current inputs are consistent; the gap is future-proofing only.
defects.reproducer: Reviewer check: np.array_equal on all three arrays passed 2026-11-18.
defects.expected: Array identity assertions in the runner itself.
defects.actual: Passes today by external verification only.
defects.recommended_fix: Extend the reuse validation with array-equality checks (cheap, read-only).

defects.title: knn_reference_bank allocation comment says 'largest class' absorbs remainder; code absorbs into classes[0]
defects.evidence: allocation[0] += budget - allocation.sum() adds the rounding remainder to the FIRST class in np.unique order (class 0), not the largest. Coincides with 'largest' here because negatives are the majority in every fold.
defects.reproducer: Synthetic bank with class-1 majority: remainder still goes to class 0.
defects.actual: Comment overstates; behavior is still stratified and deterministic.
defects.recommended_fix: Fix comment or absorb into argmax(counts).

defects.title: results.json elapsed_seconds_note claims separate processes unconditionally
defects.evidence: The note states stages ran as separate processes even when --stage all ran them in one process.
defects.recommended_fix: Record the actual per-stage invocation mode.

ci_review_notes: .github/workflows/ci.yml installs requirements.txt (numpy 2.5.5, scipy 1.18.0, scikit-learn 1.8.0, joblib 1.5.3, fastapi, uvicorn, httpx, pydantic, matplotlib, folium, reportlab, pillow) plus editable package, then runs: python -m unittest discover -s tests; python -B -m unittest discover -s infrastructure -p test_hosting.py; node frontend/smoke.mjs && node --test tests/frontend_adapter.test.mjs. All four entry points reproduce locally and pass as of 2026-11-18 (120, 28, smoke, 8 tests).

Gap: no phase-three-specific unit/regression tests (e.g., the PH3-D001 miss-assertion semantics, knn_reference_bank invariants, encode/decode bounds) — reviewer verified these by synthetic one-off checks; suggest Lead have the test owner (tests/ scope) add permanent coverage.
Minor: threadpoolctl is used directly by run_phase_three.py but pinned only transitively via scikit-learn==1.8.0 (its dependency); explicit pin would be cleaner.
CI does not install the dev extra (playwright); live browser evidence is intentionally a local/production activity, not CI — acceptable, noted for the record.
verified_clean: Cache integrity: both frozen caches sha256-verified; TRAIN 28000 obs / 269463 rows / 80 trips / 578 target-miss obs; student 19160 / 175778 / 10 / 19; zero empty candidate sets; X 38 features float32; y in {0,1}; fingerprints consistent with filenames and coverage JSON.

Selection contract: exactly the three requested families (logistic_regression, knn_distance_weighted, bagging); objective = out-of-fold equal-trip mean top1 proxy accuracy with tie-break (macro_f1, -log_loss); TRAIN grouped CV only; student cache and student graphs are loaded exclusively in stage_student after require(selection.json) + require(model_freeze.json) + require(bayesian_optimization.json) gates; results.json records student_test_consulted=false for cv/select/hpo stages.

Estimator standardity: pure sklearn — LogisticRegression(lbfgs) and KNeighborsClassifier(weights=distance) each inside a fold-local StandardScaler Pipeline; BaggingClassifier over DecisionTreeClassifier (bootstrap max_samples 0.7) with no learned preprocessing. No custom model class, no metric-aware fitting, no relabeling.

Trip weighting: training_weights = inverse candidate count per observation x inverse sampled observations per trip, mean-1 normalized; label-free; applied via sample_weight for LR/Bagging and via KNN bank inclusion probabilities (fit accepts no sample_weight) — documented in model metadata.

KNN reference bank (60k budget): class-stratified weight-proportional sampling without replacement from the FIT's train rows only. Synthetic audit passed: deterministic per seed, fold seeds 0/1/2 distinct from final fit seed 3, bank immune to mutations outside its row slice (fold locality), class prior preserved, no duplicates, budget capped at available rows, heavy-weight rows included proportionally. No validation-fold leakage: validation rows never enter the bank; labels are used only to stratify the bank's own train rows.

GP-EI is genuine: GaussianProcessRegressor (Matern 5/2 + WhiteKernel, normalize_y) conditioned only on measured CV objectives; analytic expected improvement with exploration xi=0.0003 matching the recorded value; proposal pool 2048 uniform + 1024 incumbent-neighborhood; dedup; seeded RNG. Budget accounting recorded per trial (see PH3-D006).

Probability domain: predict_positive_proba validates binary classes and probability sums and clips to [1e-7, 1-1e-7]; saved KNN OOF probabilities empirically span exactly [1e-07, 0.9999999]; emissions normalized within candidate set; categorical NLL floors target mass at 1e-7 before -log and never reclips the normalized vector; candidate-miss observations retained in denominators (strata report them separately).

Export mechanics: joblib bundle of standard sklearn objects written atomically (tmp + os.replace); metadata records feature names/version, weighting, sampling, emission policy, versions, hardware; feature schema JSON documents row order and that reference routes are never features; historical artifacts/model.joblib and root artifacts/* are never written by phase code (writes confined to artifacts/phase_three/ and experiments/phase_three/).
encode/decode round-trip: all three search spaces verified — prior decodes to itself; 500 random unit-cube vectors per space decode within declared bounds; dims 1/1/4.

Decoder script (f52f27fe...): refuse-overwrite guards on declare/search/ablate; model sha256 verified before and during search (runtime mutation detection); TRAIN-only calibration on the 8 fixed CALIBRATION_IDS with bounds-bounded sigma/beta; writes only reports/phase_three/decoder/ and artifacts/phase_three/match_config.json; graph-namespaced directed-edge labels.

Live evidence script: reconciles health against decoder freeze (model sha, compact-JSON config hash, trip_count 10, cache disabled), scans public payloads for private reference fields, exercises real POST matches and invalid/untrusted-origin requests, real Chromium network load of the served map — no request interception or mocks.

Visualization generator: writes only under visualizations/phase_three/, reads only measured stable files (results.json, decoder ablation, Lead CLI route output), no fabricated epoch curves, reuses historical assets read-only.

Baseline test evidence (clean env, 2026-11-18): .venv-clean python -m unittest discover -s tests: 120 tests OK; python -B -m unittest discover -s infrastructure -p test_hosting.py: 28 tests OK; node frontend/smoke.mjs: PASS; node --test tests/frontend_adapter.test.mjs: 8/8 pass.
